Quantitative Trader

Overview

We are looking for a Quantitative Trader to join our systematic trading desk. You will own strategy research end to end, from signal generation through execution, on a team that ships to production continuously.

What you will do

  • Research and backtest systematic trading strategies in Python and C++.
  • Own the full lifecycle of a strategy, including risk and execution quality.
  • Collaborate with engineers on low-latency infrastructure.

What we are looking for

  • Strong grounding in probability, statistics and time-series analysis.
  • Production experience in Python; C++ is a plus.
  • A degree in a quantitative field.
